communication_goal: 确认空输入的校验行为与提示文案。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Make named learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI marks allowed. Scene: Two adult stick figures facing a large front-facing desktop monitor centered on a desk. Screen displays only ONE large rounded rectangular EMPTY input field, a small unlabeled rounded submit button below it and a simple exclamation icon away from the field. Left person points at the blank field, right person explains with open palm. Field border fully visible, blank inside. Make field large enough to crop independently.

image_review.summary: 通过：两人讨论空输入的行为，中央屏幕有完整大空白输入框和独立提示图标，无文字。左侧指尖触及输入框边界少量区域，不遮挡空白内容；具体校验与提示文案由对白约定。
